rationale: The base station showed online=false with uplink_status=no_internet and error E-503, and the customer reported a solid red LED (no internet uplink) plus a neighbourhood broadband outage after a thunderstorm. All six devices appeared offline because the master base station had lost its uplink. The standard L1 fix (power-cycling the router and base station) restored the uplink: LED turned solid blue and all devices came back online, confirming the root cause.

args.action: Ask the customer to power-cycle their broadband router/modem (unplug power for 30 seconds, plug back in, wait for it to fully reconnect), then power-cycle the base station (unplug for 10 seconds, plug back in). After both are back up, check whether the base station LED turns solid blue and whether devices come back online in the app.

results.text: The base station could not deliver events to the cloud. Frontline action: verify internet access, restart router and base station, set router DNS to automatic. If E-503 persists after these steps while the base station is online, escalate to FAE (cloud channel or certificate issue).

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.
